items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Well, John, I played with him. He was pretty, he was pretty good.

ctx.x: Well you think there was any hoodoo or anything tied in with it? Mmhmm. You think there was any hoodoo or anything like that tied in with it? No.

He says, I know huh? How do you think it happened? Well, you know I tell you, they colored people got something the funnest idea you've ever seen. They can go over to a person over there and say give me something I'm gonna do something about it or something. You give them some money and they give you that and if you put it where they tell you it, they blow it up. Yeah. Yeah they do that. I know Buddy Petit. Buddy Petit, we all was walking around here and wasn't doing nothing but one band was playing Saturday and…
Three houses with the girls. Three houses, huh? Yeah. I mean, this is Beth Russ. Huh?
